14.name: rayner_inside_bar
14.title: Rayner Teo 10 EMA + Inside Bar Momentum Breakout (H1)
raw_tp: We will open daily timeframe chart of a liquid stock on trading view, put EMA 10 indicator on it, and when the price moves above EMA 10 indicator, then we will find inside bar candle which is a candle which easily fits inside high and low of the previous candle, thus it is called inside bar candle and the larger bar is called Mother candle.
